name: Gaza Trauma Triage Scenarios
description: Trauma scenarios relevant to conflict zone hospital operations

scenarios.name: Multi-Casualty Blast Event
scenarios.description: Airstrike on residential building. 12 casualties arriving simultaneously. Mix of blast, crush, and penetrating injuries.

patient_profiles.presentation: 28-year-old male, blast wave exposure, bilateral tympanic membrane rupture, complaining of chest pain and shortness of breath
45-year-old female, extracted from rubble after 6 hours, both legs were trapped, now complaining of severe pain and dark urine
10-year-old child, walking, crying, superficial lacerations on arms from glass, no other injuries

scenarios.name: Fuel Depot Fire
scenarios.description: Explosion at fuel storage. 8 casualties with varying degrees of burn injuries.

patient_profiles.presentation: 35-year-old male, 60% TBSA full-thickness burns, inhalation injury, intubated in field
22-year-old female, partial-thickness burns to both arms (18% TBSA), alert, breathing normally

scenarios.name: Multi-Story Building Collapse
scenarios.description: Residential building collapse. Casualties extracted over several hours. Mix of crush injuries, fractures, and internal bleeding.

patient_profiles.presentation: 55-year-old male, open fracture right femur, tourniquet applied, conscious but confused, BP 80/50
patient_profiles.expected_diagnosis: Hemorrhagic shock from open femur fracture

patient_profiles.presentation: 30-year-old female, closed fracture left humerus, alert, ambulatory with support, stable vitals

scenarios.name: Penetrating Trauma Wave
scenarios.description: Multiple casualties with projectile and shrapnel injuries arriving over 30 minutes.

patient_profiles.presentation: 19-year-old male, entry wound right chest 4th intercostal space, exit wound posterior, decreasing oxygen saturation, tracheal deviation to left
40-year-old female, shrapnel wound to left forearm, controlled bleeding, sensation and motor intact, stable vitals
